Also worth knowing: the new order is #1001, but orders.csv jumps to 1042/1043. Numbering doesn't match — I left both files untouched.

counter.txt is now "count: 1" (was 0), confirmed by reading it back — so order #1002 is counted once.

Two things you should know:
1. I could not run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` was permission-denied (no approver available this run). The counter change is data-only, but the suite is unverified by me.
